name: inference_logger
summary: Append-only blake3-chained audit trail of every inference call. The crystal chain. Tamper-evident; verifiable by replaying every hash.
engine_pattern: writes one JSONL line per InferenceRecord; the chain is then walked by CrystalChainCursor in moe_router (XMLParser-shaped)

outbound_calls: blake3 (or blake2b fallback) for crystal hashing

guarantees: Tamper-evident — every record blake3-chains via prev_crystal
Deterministic — same input → same crystal_id, byte-for-byte
Backward-compatible — old records missing reasoning_layer_v1 fields still verify
Genesis-anchored — chain starts with a deterministic genesis record
v1_extension_2026_05_28: Added reasoning_trace, forward_chain_inline, forward_chain_posthoc, forward_source. SemanticIndex now indexes these fields too.
usage_example:
from inference_logger import InferenceLogger
logger = InferenceLogger()
crystal = logger.log(original_prompt='...', enhanced_prompt='...', output_text='...', tier='large', model='claude-sonnet-4-6', scope='broad', reasoning_trace='...', forward_chain_posthoc='- step1\n- step2', forward_source='posthoc')
assert logger.verify_chain()
